parlerò.consejo: First singular person from the future of «parlare».

parlerai.consejo: Second person singular of the future.

parlerà.consejo: Third person singular of the future.

parleremo.consejo: First plural person of the future.

partirà.en: He will go out; he will go out.

texto: In Italian, the three regular conjugations form the future on a basis with **-r-** followed by the same disinences for all verbs: **-ò, -ai, -à, -emo, -ete, -anno**.

The verbs in **-are** change the thematic **-a-** by **-e-** (* parlare → parlerò, parlerai, parlerà... *), as well as the verbs in **-ere** (* prendere → prenderò... *). The verbs in **-ire** maintain their **-i-** (* dormire → dormirò... *).
Remember that the first person singular (**-ò**) and the third singular (**-à**) always have a serious graphic accent: **parlerò**, **sentirà**.

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: morphology of the regular simple future

frases.it: Quando parlerai con il nuovo direttore dei tuoi progetti?
frases.es: ¿Cuándo hablarás con el nuevo director de tus proyectos?
frases.en: When will you talk to the new project manager?

frases.it: Gli parlerò domani mattina durante la riunione delle dieci.
frases.es: Le hablaré mañana por la mañana durante la reunión de las diez.
frases.en: I'll talk to you tomorrow morning during the 10: 00 meeting.

frases.it: E a che ora finirà il vostro incontro di lavoro?
frases.es: ¿Y a qué hora terminará vuestro encuentro de trabajo?
frases.en: And what time will your work meeting end?

frases.it: Finirà verso mezzogiorno: poi partirò subito per Bologna.
frases.es: Terminará hacia el mediodía: después partiré de inmediato hacia Bolonia.
frases.en: It will end by noon: then I will leave immediately for Bologna.

bloques.pregunta: What vocal change do the verbs of the first conjugation (-are) experience in the regular future?

opciones.texto: Cambian la vocal temática «-a-» por «-e-»: «parlare → parlerò».
opciones.explicacion: In standard Italian the deinence of the future of the verbs in -are is based on the thematic vocal «e».
Non-standard form in the contemporary language.
This thematic vocal corresponds to the third conjugation.

bloques.pregunta: What people of the simple future are required to have a graphic label in Italian?

opciones.texto: The first person singular (-ò) and the third person singular (-à).
opciones.explicacion: «Io parlerò» and «lui/lei parlerà» require final serious graphic accent.

opciones.texto: The first plural person (-emo) and the second plural (-ete).
opciones.explicacion: The plural forms are flat and do not have tylde written.

opciones.texto: Exclusively the form of second person singular (-ai).
opciones.explicacion: The shape in -ai does not have a graphic accent.

opciones.explicacion: First plural person with regular termination «-eremo».
It corresponds to the first person singular («io parlerò»).
It corresponds to the third plural person («loro parleranno»).
